meta.title: Mail: email on your domain for you and your AI agents | MepMail
meta.description: Email on your domain, no hosting. You and your AI agent in the same mailbox: it reads and drafts over MCP, and you review and take over whenever you want. Plans from US$ 2.90 a month, with 7 days free.

hero.eyebrow: MepMail Mail · email on your domain, for you and your agents
hero.title: Your domain. Your email. Your agents.
hero.lead: Bought a domain? Get email on it without paying for hosting. Use it in the browser or the Windows and Linux apps, and connect agents to the mailboxes you choose: you and your agent in the same mailbox.
hero.note: Mail is paid separately. Initial access is exclusive to eligible earlier subscribers; this preview presents the new offer.

use.title: A mailbox that can work with you.
use.body: Your work email, company support and agent have different contexts. Create separate mailboxes and follow each conversation in the same dashboard.

items.title: Talk from your own address.
items.body: Read, reply to and forward messages. Your signature follows new messages and replies.

items.title: Give your agent an email.
items.body: It can read messages, prepare replies and, with your authorization, send. Follow drafts and messages in the dashboard.
points: A key scoped to one mailbox

control.title: Start with drafts. Expand when it makes sense.
control.body: Give the agent only the permissions it needs. A read-and-draft key lets it prepare a reply while you review and send from the dashboard.

permissions.body: Access messages in the authorized mailbox.

permissions.title: Draft
permissions.body: Prepare replies for review in the dashboard.

setup.title: Your domain is the beginning.
setup.body: You do not need website hosting to have email on your domain. You need to control the domain and configure where messages go.

steps.title: Check your Send plan
steps.body: The first opening remains for eligible earlier subscribers to plans with a recurring price above US$ 20/month. The new US$ 29 offer is being validated in this preview. Mail is paid separately, per mailbox.

steps.title: Connect a domain you own
steps.body: Verify that you control the domain and configure the required authentication records.

steps.title: Configure receiving
steps.body: Update DNS and MX as directed by the service. The domain and receiving infrastructure must be confirmed before messages can arrive.

steps.title: Create the mailbox and choose who uses it
steps.body: Set its address, owner and whether it is for a person or an agent. Then configure access permissions.

setup.warningTitle: Already receiving email on this domain?
setup.warning: Changing MX redirects receiving for the entire domain or subdomain. Plan the switch before editing DNS. Connecting the domain does not import messages from your previous provider.

integrations.title: Connect with clarity about what your agent can access.
integrations.body: Send and Mail have their own functions and authorizations. Choose the right connection for the task.

items.title: A mailbox for your agent
items.body: The Mail API can retrieve messages, create drafts and send authorized drafts, using a key dedicated to the mailbox.

items.title: Your agent in Send
items.body: The MepMail MCP connects compatible clients to Send, through hosted OAuth or the official local package. With the mail permissions it also reads and drafts in the inboxes you tick when you connect it, with no key to paste.

items.title: Your agent inside the mailbox
items.body: The Mail MCP gives the agent its own inbox as tools: list, read, draft and send. Without the send permission it asks for your approval before each send.

plans.title: A plan for your application. Mailboxes for your conversations.
plans.body: Send handles application emails and campaigns. Mail adds inboxes and outboxes for people and agents, paid separately. Initial access remains closed to eligible earlier subscribers.

items.q: Do I need a Send plan to use Mail?
items.a: No. Mail plans work on their own: Solo US$ 2.90 a month with 1 mailbox, Duo US$ 5.90 with 3 or Equipe US$ 12.90 with 10, with 7 days free. Each plan's storage, sends and received messages are shared by its mailboxes, with up to 3 domains. Existing subscriptions keep their terms without automatic migration. The internal System license remains exempt, with 50 GiB per mailbox and no commercial mailbox or delivery limits.

items.q: I bought a domain. Can I create any address now?
items.a: You can choose an available address on a domain you control. Sending and receiving require a Mail subscription (on its own or with a Send plan), domain verification, DNS/MX configuration and confirmed receiving activation. If your DNS is at Cloudflare, the dashboard creates the sending records for you. Registering an address alone does not complete these steps.

items.q: Do I need a website or hosting?
items.a: You do not need to host a website. You need a domain and access to its DNS records to verify ownership and configure email. The mailbox service is provided by MepMail Mail once activated.

items.q: Does the agent have access to my entire operation?
items.a: Not automatically. In Mail, each key authorizes one mailbox and the permissions its owner selects. Access to other company tools or data depends on their respective connections and authorizations.

items.q: Can the agent send without my review?
items.a: Only if you grant send permission. We recommend starting with read and draft: the agent prepares a reply and you review it in the dashboard before sending.

items.q: Can I bring messages from Gmail or another provider?
items.a: Connecting a domain does not move old messages. From Mail you can import a mailbox's history over IMAP from Gmail, Outlook or another provider, using an app password where the provider requires one; MBOX/PST files are not imported yet. Keep access to your current provider during the transition.

items.q: Does Mail work with agents over MCP?
items.a: Yes. Mail has its own MCP: connect Claude, Cursor or another MCP client with a per-mailbox agent key, or through the MepMail MCP by choosing which mailboxes it may use. The agent reads and drafts, and each send can wait for your approval. There is also a REST API with per-mailbox keys.

items.q: How will I access it on my computer and phone?
items.a: In a browser, through the MepMail dashboard, on computers and phones, or with the Windows app you can download on this page. An iOS app is not published yet.
